**********************

notes_beta:
May 26th 2026
Version 10.2+ (stable) / 10.4+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Live Editor: Global Settings now spans 9 tabs — Master Tune (with inline Transpose + UPG Filter), Scale Tuning, Bellows/Audio, System, Layout (FR-8X only: Bass & Chord Mode + Free Bass Mode), Switches & Pedal (6 Function Switches + 9/15 Foot Controller slots + button-press shortcuts), Sustain (Sust A / Sust B routing per orchestra section), Speaker EQ (FR-4X only: 4-band parametric per Right/Left Hand speaker), and MIDI (R)
* Preferences window reformatted into a two-column layout so the OK button stays visible on smaller Windows screens (R K)
* Subscribe / Activate dialog: new "Ask a Question" button next to Download Update — lets users locked out by activation contact support directly without needing the main menu (R K)
* Fixed giant text in right-click menus on Windows VMs caused by font inheritance from scaled parent dialogs (R K)
* Korg backup tree no longer slowly scrolls on its own (K)
* Fixed a latent bug where simply hovering the cursor near the tree edge would activate the drag-only edge auto-scroll (K)
* Bass editor (FR-8X only): added Voicing control (Accordion / Mode 1 / Mode 2) — matches Roland's own Bass editor, lets you change the bass voicing engine per register (R)
* Live Editor: changing an orchestra tone (Orch 1/2, Orch Chord, Orch Free Bass) now re-syncs the editor with the accordion's auto-applied MFX defaults so the next Send doesn't revert them (R)
